name: teamwork-skill
description: Codex-first collaboration skills, with Cursor and Claude Code adapters, for Collaborate, case-bundle workflow documents, research, local evidence, debugging, planning, review, setup, updates, and long-running goals.

interface.shortDescription: Nine focused skills for Collaborate, durable results, research, debugging, review, setup, and goals.
interface.longDescription: Teamwork adds nine focused collaboration skills for adaptive dialogue and brainstorming; cited external research; read-only local evidence; hypothesis-first debugging; executable planning; independent review; project initialization; global refresh; and persistent goals. A lean global policy keeps ordinary work on Codex's native fast path, while each selected skill loads its own method and owning agent role. Unavailable mandatory roles return capability-blocked. Durable workflow state uses case-v2 bundles only; a completed method still returns its result when Writer persistence fails, clearly marked unsaved, while dependent continuity waits for transaction readback. Init and Update can semantically migrate one explicitly authorized legacy project root into case-v2. You choose scope and authorize effects; Codex remains in control of tools and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use $teamwork-update to enable full Teamwork for this Codex plugin.
Use $teamwork-collaborate to brainstorm this problem with me and ask the most useful next question.
Use $teamwork-research to investigate this current external question from primary sources with linked citations.
